decisions.reason: Selecting blog keywords does not necessarily select or change the blog topics.
The source explicitly identifies blog keywords and does not change the separate campaign keyword list or its existing replacement keyword.
The blog keyword selection does not change the requirement to produce and publish three blog articles during the trial.
The source lists blog keywords but does not state that search-volume metrics must be added for them or otherwise modify the search-volume requirement.
The selected blog keywords do not change backlink quantity, delivery timing, or dofollow and nofollow proportions.
